explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/720 (Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp): if C_n is the cycle with n edges, is R̂(C_n) = o(n²)? Yes (Beck: R̂(C_n) ≪ n). The Lean statement: sizeRamsey(C_n, C_n)/n² → 0, with cycleGraph n the n-cycle (degenerate small n do not affect the limit) and sizeRamsey the standard 2-colour size Ramsey number. Faithful.
